beats.text: The Windows 95 startup sound was written by Brian Eno, on a Mac.
beats.note: He said: I have never used a PC in my life.

beats.name: Brian Eno
beats.role: Ambient music pioneer commissioned by Microsoft designers Mark Malamud and Erik Gavriluk.

beats.text: The brief asked for music that was inspiring, optimistic, futuristic and sentimental.
beats.note: And it had to be 3.25 seconds long.

beats.context: How many short compositions Eno wrote for that one sound.

beats.text: The sound has since been preserved by the Library of Congress.
beats.note: It was added to the National Recording Registry in 2025.

beats.text: One of the most heard sounds in computing came from eighty four tries.
